lines: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about it?

Would you like to live there in the future?
What do you study?

Do you prefer studying alone or with others?

Is there a hobby you would like to try?

Do you often cook at home?
Is there any food you didn't like as a child but like now?
Do people in your country eat out a lot?
What's the weather like where you live?
What kind of weather do you like best?
Does the weather affect your mood?
Has the weather in your area changed in recent years?
How often do you use your phone?

Would you like to buy a car in the future?
Has transport in your city improved recently?

Did you learn to play an instrument as a child?
Do you prefer listening to music alone or with others?

Do you like reading?

What was the last book you read?
Did you read a lot as a child?
What is your daily routine like?
Which part of the day do you like most?

Would you like to change anything in your routine?
What is the most important holiday in your country?
What do you usually do during Tet?

Do you prefer relaxing holidays or active ones?

Now I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a skill you would like to learn.
Which skills are most important for young people today?
Do you think schools teach enough practical skills?
Is it easier to learn a skill when you are young?

Now I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a person who has influenced you.
Who has more influence on children: parents or teachers?
Do you think celebrities are good role models?
How do young people choose who to follow on social media?

Now I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time you used technology to solve a problem.
Has technology made people's lives easier?
Are older people less comfortable with technology?
Will technology replace teachers in the future?
